user.title: Create a stopwatch
user.description: Create a new stopwatch, for example for gaming or work time.

data_description.name: Used for the device and its entities, e.g. "Gaming".
data_description.interval: Fire an interval event every time this much running time has passed. 0 turns it off. At most 24 hours.
data_description.update_interval: How often the elapsed time sensor is updated while running, between 1 second and 1 hour. Shorter intervals write more data to the database.

source.name: Source entity
source.description: Optional: let the stopwatch follow an entity, e.g. a game console. It runs while the entity is in one of the running states and pauses otherwise.

data.auto_reset: Reset automatically for a new session

data_description.source_entity: Leave empty to control the stopwatch only with buttons, actions and automations.
data_description.running_states: States of the source entity in which the stopwatch runs, e.g. "playing" or "on". You can type your own.
data_description.grace_period: If the source is unavailable or unknown for longer than this, the stopwatch pauses, backdated to the start of the dropout. 0 turns the grace period off: unavailable then pauses right away like any other non-running state. At most 1 hour.
data_description.auto_reset: When the source starts running again after a long inactivity, the stopwatch is reset first.
data_description.auto_reset_delay: How long the source must be inactive for its next start to count as a new session, at most 7 days. 0: every new start of the source begins a new session.

error.interval_too_long: The interval can be at most 24 hours.
error.update_interval_out_of_range: The update interval must be between 1 second and 1 hour.
error.running_states_required: Select at least one running state for the source entity.
error.grace_period_too_long: The grace period can be at most 1 hour.
error.auto_reset_delay_too_long: The inactivity before a new session can be at most 7 days.

no_stopwatch_targeted.message: No loaded stopwatch was targeted. Select a Stopwatch Plus entity or device.

start.name: Start
start.description: Starts the targeted stopwatches, or resumes them when they are paused.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Resets the targeted stopwatches to zero and stops them.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: Pauses the targeted stopwatches when they are running, otherwise starts them.
